views.markdown:
Adds a heart button to the lock screen to like or unlike the currently playing Spotify track, without opening the app.

Works across two processes: com.apple.MediaRemoteUI draws the button against the real transport controls (so it stays aligned in both the compact and full-screen player layouts), and Spotify itself handles the actual like/unlike action. State stays in sync between them in real time.

### 1.4
Fixed the heart dropping out of line when the lock screen player is expanded to full screen (iOS 16).

### 1.3
iOS 17 finally working, plus NextUp3 compatibility

### 1.2
Fixed heart fill state (finally)

### 1.1
Fixed heart state sync, unlike, and dynamic position

### 1.0
Initial release
